title: Dragon Pavilion, Kaifeng
geometryBasis: Exact marked extent of the red-faced platform and south stair. The operator’s 13 m base and 26.7 m total height establish the two main section heights.
sectionBasis: The three exact Qualla public-domain views and official scenic site identifying the 72 stone steps, central carved dragon ramp, imperial balustrades and double yellow-glazed hip-and-gable roof.
limitations: The recognizable exterior covers the standing pavilion, raised red platform, stone balustrades and two 72-step runs with a carved central ramp.

Official total height and platform height are used. Roof curvature, timber bay widths, small ridge figures, eastern lower extension levels and stone relief pattern are estimated from the mapped plan and public-domain photographs.
The original terrain is preserved. It is a coarse elevation field and the platform step levels are approximate. Temporary vegetation, signs and park features outside the named approach are excluded.
